items.name: pixel-swap
items.title: Pixel Swap
items.description: New content builds in pixel by pixel in a springy wave that starts wherever the cursor enters.

items.name: swarm-cursor
items.title: Swarm Cursor
items.description: A liquid swarm of particles that flows after the cursor, curls into eddies and pours around hovered buttons.

items.name: scroll-expand
items.title: Scroll Expand
items.description: A rounded media frame that grows to full bleed as it scrolls through the viewport.

items.name: sticker-peel
items.title: Sticker Peel
items.description: A die-cut WebGL sticker that peels at the edge nearest the cursor and can be dragged, thrown and swung, in gloss, matte or holo finishes.

items.name: halftone-reveal
items.title: Halftone Reveal
items.description: Prints an image as a mono, duotone or color halftone whose dots swell into the real photo under the pointer.

items.name: micro-slats
items.title: Micro Slats
items.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests and a cursor-stirred fluid trail.

items.name: ripple-distortion
items.title: Ripple Distortion
items.description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps an image and leaves a decaying wake.

items.name: topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: A 3D landscape drawn in glowing contour lines that rises under the cursor, with light pulses on click.

items.name: annotated-text
items.title: Annotated Text
items.description: Inline text marked with hand-drawn SVG circles, underlines, highlights, brackets and cross-outs that draw in once when they scroll into view.

items.name: ascii-effect
items.title: ASCII Effect
items.description: Renders an image as dithered ASCII characters on a canvas, with static, flowing pointer-ripple, and glitch-reveal variants.

items.name: aurora-flow
items.title: Aurora Flow
items.description: WebGL hero background with layered silk flow, diffused aurora light, film grain and a soft pointer bend, with twelve palette presets.

items.name: case-study-flip-stack
items.title: Case Study Flip Stack
items.description: Editorial case study cards that fold upward on scroll to reveal the next story beneath.

items.name: fisheye-infinite-grid
items.title: Fisheye Infinite Grid
items.description: A draggable image wall that repeats on both axes and bends through one fisheye lens, with momentum, wheel and arrow-key panning.

items.name: flipping-word-swap
items.title: Flipping Word Swap
items.description: A word that flips into a second word one character at a time on hover, focus or tap, and flips back when you leave.

items.name: grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient
items.description: A breathing color field with a soft curved shadow, flowing light and fine film grain, drawn with WebGL.

items.name: hover-transition
items.title: Hover Transition
items.description: A focusable wrapper that swaps a default and a hover slot with one of eight transitions from nine directions, plus a light tilt and glare.

items.name: lens-clock
items.title: Lens Clock
items.description: A live clock that frames a corner of a large dial, panning with the hour hand while the edges blur out of focus.

items.name: newsletter-bookshelf
items.title: Newsletter Bookshelf
items.description: A three.js shelf of cloth-bound books for a newsletter archive. Browse sideways, hover to lift a spine, click to pull a book forward.

items.name: pixel-image-trail
items.title: Pixel Image Trail
items.description: An image reveal made from cursor-painted squares that expire into a bounded pixel trail.

items.name: scroll-tilted-grid
items.title: Scroll Tilted Grid
items.description: A two-column image gallery whose frames tilt, blur and dim at the viewport edges and settle into focus as they cross the center.

items.name: spectral-ribbon
items.title: Spectral Ribbon
items.description: A soft spectral light ribbon on black with slow liquid motion and a rainbow fringe, drawn by one WebGL fragment shader.

items.name: spiral-3d-slider
items.title: Spiral 3D Slider
items.description: An autoplaying image gallery that flows along a 3D spiral of curved WebGL planes and moves with wheel and page scroll.

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text Morph
items.description: Words, numbers or prices melt into each other on a timer through blur and an SVG alpha-threshold filter, inheriting parent typography.

items.name: wheel-carousel
items.title: Wheel Carousel
items.description: A rotating-wheel picker with inertial drag and scroll, curved fading labels, and a crossfading image for the active item.

items.name: clean-table
items.title: Clean Table
items.description: A quiet, paginated table with segmented tabs, a keyboard-focused search, zebra rows, mono columns, status pills and row selection.

items.name: control-card
items.title: Control Card
items.description: A frosted-glass device card with a round power button, a device name and a boxed stat, made to sit over a photo.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A sortable, searchable table on TanStack Table with cell slots and a flash on rows whose values change.

items.name: status-panel
items.title: Status Panel
items.description: Service health lamps with an overall status, uptime and latency, plus a live event log.
